name: AI Media and Visual Repository
blurb: Keynotes, conference talks, tutorials, podcasts with transcripts, and a diagram and image library.

built.name: Video Library
built.detail: This section covers video worth watching on AI: vendor keynotes where model and hardware announcements land, practitioner conference talks, university course lecture series, and standalone explainers that became the field's default onboarding.

built.name: Podcasts
built.detail: This section curates podcasts covering AI research, engineering, and industry strategy, tracking each show's host, focus, and whether transcripts are published, rather than pulling from a live episode feed or download-ranking data.
